creator: Alexander Terp
description: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-14, 0.16.0 on the devenv. The council skill (`extras/skill/council/SKILL.md`) has every directing agent take the name `director`, and `directed.toml` grants that name its powers, but a participant's name is unique on its machine. A second review session convening its own council while the first was still running was refused: "director is the name of a session that is still running ...; join under another name". It made the group anyway and stranded it (card a_2izzZYN6K). The member name it meant to use, `reviewer`, was held by another live council too. The workaround was a copy of the policy with `director-<change>` in place of `director`, a second group, and telling the reviewer to join as `reviewer-<change>`. One option is a policy role meaning the group's maker, so `directed.toml` needs no fixed name. Another is the skill naming each director per group (`director-<group>`), with `group new` filling that name into the preset. Either way the Convening section's "The name `director` outlives each council" changes with it. Related: a_2cW57qOIs (joining as director keeps a gone session's groups), a_2hIfss6pW.
title: Two directed councils at once collide on the name director
